findings: Prior near/far retained only 13%/4.5% of whole leaves then enlarged each by 2.2x/3.2x; sparse detached silhouette follows directly.
Prior whole-tree scaling from 3.4m to 14m compounded oversized leaves and pale forked trunk repetition.
Poly Haven glTF diffuse JPEGs have no alpha channel although leaf materials request BLEND; separate official alpha must be embedded.
Prior procedural wind was applied to visible material only, not custom shadow depth.

limits: CPU checks are not visual or runtime acceptance. Await main new headless frames and 1080p benchmark; no AAA pass.
Tree Small 02 is Burkea africana, a visual stand-in rather than a verified Vietnamese species.
More complete foliage geometry intentionally increases the prior ~10.9M worst-case triangle baseline. Spatial culling reduces actual visibility but is not a substitute for measured performance.
Compound leaves use bounded curvature approximation and 512px source-clipped tiles in a 2048px atlas. Far retains 86% components. Review movement/shimmer and silhouette, not merely one still.
Public deployment should include only the current publicWhitelist GLBs, foliage-revision.json and vegetation.js; source originals/toolchain stay off web.

Bermuda infill is much cheaper in triangles but introduces 16 additional draws and overlapping alpha-tested blades. Verify visible density, natural leaf scale, overdraw and movement shimmer in current-build evidence.
Whole-scene 1080p p95/p99<=33.3ms and max<=50ms remain unchanged. Main reported prior p99~16.8ms with two hitches; that does not qualify this revision.

derivationNotes: Near canopy retains all original connected leaf components; far retains 86% deterministically with no leaf enlargement. Simple leaves use source-topology/UV-weighted edge collapse and measured area bounds.

Compound-twig envelopes preserve source boundary positions and use a source-supported center. Their opacity is clipped to the original source UV triangles in a dedicated atlas tile: neighbouring atlas leaves are not exposed. >=98% near/95% far sampled opaque coverage; <=5% near/7.5% far RMS 3D warp. Full source-topology fallback if any constraint fails.
Trees use two authored crown/trunk shapes at near 10.4m/11.6m and far 12.8m/14m plus bounded instance scale. Whole-tree scale differs from the scan; individual leaf scale compensation is never used.

Official alpha remains unflipped and uninﬂated. RGB-only 8px transparent gutter prevents black-matte filtering fringes. ARM uses AO red/roughness green; leaf AO .18 and nearly neutral linear tint replace .65 AO and the dark sRGB multiplier.
Original grass_medium layers retain a 40% triangle target with <=0.7% local-extent error and UV weighting. They remain unchanged in the Bermuda follow-up.

Playable infill keeps the same jittered .27m lattice and coherent patch gaps: banks x~+/-6..8, outer house margins, and between houses. Only the infill species changes to grass_bermuda_01 small_a/b/c and medium_c. Their unchanged source topology totals 62 triangles across four variants; heights .14/.18/.22/.23m avoid inflating the flattened tufts. Runtime.infill records counts and cost.

Bermuda comes from the existing official CC0 package verified against asset-sources.json SHA256/MD5/size; no network download. Its separate compact GLB embeds official alpha with RGB gutter and verifies winding. The preceding six GLBs are unchanged. Four variants in four sectors add 16 non-shadow draws, no new trees or shadow batches.

Map predicate, cabin exclusions, dirt lanes and crossings remain enforced per tuft. No woody bounds intersect play. Visible/depth/distance wind is identical and bounded. Every public asset and manifest replaces atomically.
integrationFixes: Historical intermediate grass Uint16 data was incorrectly declared/encoded with a 32-bit stride; all emitted indices are now Uint32 and all decoded index/accessor checks pass.
Tree_small_02 UV1 is VEC2; branch textures preserve that channel.
03:33 raw convex-hull leaf derivation reversed area-weighted winding by 100% for island_tree_01 and ~70.7% for tree_small_02. Current decoded MASK geometry is checked for zero reversed area.

Raw compound UV envelopes exposed neighbouring atlas leaves (sampled excess 13%–122% depending source shape). Derived compound atlas opacity is now intersected with each component original UV footprint.

Official alpha/diffuse channel alignment was correct; neither is flipped. The prior dark tint multiplied linear albedo by roughly .47/.55/.39 before AO and instance colour, unnecessarily crushing leaf bodies.
No-post diagnostic retained the failure, so SSAO was not its primary cause. Main owns potential alpha-aware SSAO follow-up.
